item.description: Luke wrote his Gospel under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit after carefully researching the life of Jesus Christ (Luke 1:1-4).

item.title: Elkhart Man Enters Plea Agreement For 18-Hour Standoff, Son’s Death
item.description: An Elkhart man pleaded guilty but mentally ill Thursday, Dec. 4 in Elkhart County Circuit Court in connection with the death of his 2-year-old son following an 18-hour police standoff last summer.

item.title: Auburn’s Credent Wealth Management Expands Partnership To Support Growth
item.description: Credent Wealth Management a fee-only Registered Investment Advisor headquartered in Auburn with more than $4 billion in assets under management, today announced an expanded partnership with Crestline Investors, a Texas alternative investment management firm with approximately $18 billion of credit AUM.
